'''Uttak's Inn''' was a [[Hotel/Legends|hotel]] located in [[The Puddle]] that was owned by [[Uttak]]. It was a one story building that surrounded a small courtyard. It had 15 rooms that were rented out for a minimum of 20 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] but customers could be charged more if the owner felt they were bad risks. It also had a combination office/apartment that Uttak lived in.<ref name="H&S" />
